notes: Modified cash basis. Governmental lines from the Statement of Revenues, Expenditures and Changes in Fund Balances (Totals 2024 column, p6). 'Taxes' 364,687 split using the Totals column of the major funds schedule (p11): Property tax 152,614 + Motor vehicle tax 10,903 + Sales tax 201,170 (non-major funds have no taxes). 'Intergovernmental revenues' 105,299 split from the same schedule (Highway allocation, Motor vehicle fees, Homestead allocation, Other). Bond principal (55,000) and interest (5,107) are printed under other financing sources (uses), outside the Total expenditures line, and are recorded as debt service disbursements marked outside_printed_total. Business-type from the proprietary funds statement (p8, accrual-like modified cash with depreciation, measure net position); interest income 212 is non-operating, business-type receipts total = operating 180,705 + 212. The Sewer Fund's 1,434,558 loan proceeds and 1,270,855 capital purchases appear only in the cash flow statement / budgetary basis column, not in net position. Proprietary cash flows not recorded (cash basis). Balance sheet: government-wide Statement of Net Position (Totals 2024) because it holds capital assets and long-term debt. Detail: major funds schedule (pp10-11) per fund, non-major combining schedule (pp12-13) per fund (8 funds recorded individually because each fund maps to a different function), proprietary budgetary comparison Actual column (p15). The combined budget schedule (p14, General / Utility funds / Debt Service groups only) is not recorded to avoid double counting. Read pages 1-15 of 15
